identity: A UAE Ministry-of-Education social-studies (الدراسات الاجتماعية) school textbook, two consecutive lesson spreads (موقع بلادي and the opening of ثروات بلادي), flattened out of its page layout. It is not running prose: it is a mosaic of page furniture - learning-outcome bullets (نواتج التعلم), skills / glossary / values sidebars, section headings, image and map captions, first-person activity prompts (أتحقق وأتعلم, أقرأ وأستنتج, أتأمل وأجيب), fill-in-the-blank items, a dated timeline, quoted sayings of Sheikh Zayed, and short expository paragraphs. Register is didactic MSA for young learners.
law: The unit is the TYPOGRAPHIC-RHETORICAL BLOCK, not the syntactic sentence. Every heading, caption, sidebar list item, learning-outcome bullet, activity prompt, question, timeline entry and prose sentence is its own unit. Most block ends coincide with line ends and are therefore already given by the pre-<NL> rule; the real work is restoring block ends where extraction FLATTENED several blocks onto one line. Diagnostic for flattening: a stretch whose parts are demonstrably separate blocks elsewhere in this same document. Page 1 renders the skills list, the مفاهيم ومصطلحات glossary and the قيم وسلوكيات list one item per line; the last page runs the SAME sidebars together on single lines, so every item there is restored as a unit. Inside genuine running prose the unit is the sentence: I split a و- / ف- / لذلك-initial clause only when it opens a new predication with its own full nominal subject or a new topical or temporal frame; I do NOT split at فقد, فعملوا and other tight consequence clauses, at coordinated predicates sharing one subject, at التي / الذي / حيث / لأن, or at comma-style specification lists that gloss a preceding noun. Quoted sayings are single units even when internally coordinated.
reasoning: 117 line-final tokens plus token 1698 are forced; I add 64 internal boundaries. HARD SITE 1, the flattened sidebars at 1495-1528, 1530-1556, 1562-1569. Decisive internal evidence: مهارات, مهارات التفكير الناقد وحل المشكلات, جمع معلومات من مصادر مختلفة, التحديد ورسم الخرائط, الإلمام بالتكنولوجيا وتوظيفها, مفاهيم ومصطلحات الدرس, قيم وسلوكيات and الانتماء all appear as own-line units on page 1 (indices 63-136), so the same strings run together on the last page must be units there too. Bare-NP units are clearly licensed by this corpus (الغبراء 109, التجارة 119, العدالة 128). HARD SITE 2, specification lists inside a bullet: 6-15 (يتعرف الخصائص ... للدولة then الموقع الظواهر الطبيعية توزيع السكان) and 1471-1481 (... في دولته then الاختناق المروري التلوث). I do NOT split these. Page 1 is NOT flattened (every sidebar item there has its own <NL>), so the fact that these sub-items sit on the SAME line as their outcome proves they were on one line in the source, i.e. a parenthetical or colon gloss rather than separate blocks. That is the principled line between them and HARD SITE 1. HARD SITE 3, the timeline 730-780. I split at each new year label (739, 746, 753, 760, 768) because a new date unambiguously opens a new entry, but I REJECTED splitting date from event (732, 741, 748, 755, 762, 770), which I seriously considered because الألفية الرابعة ق م and عصور ما قبل التاريخ sit on two separate lines (718-728). Two reasons to reject: those two are forced pre-<NL> boundaries and so carry no information about mid-line policy; and the fact that the whole remainder extracted as ONE 51-token run argues the dates are inline in a single text run there, unlike the header band that glued أقرأ وأتعرف to the first date. YEAR + event also reads as one complete nominal sentence. HARD SITE 4, heading/body and body/heading welds, the clearest internal cuts, all hi: 479 (ذلك then من فكر الباني المؤسس), 618 and 621 (activity, then the heading الإمارات قديما وحديثا, then body), 657, 719, 867, 923 (then كلمات مضيئة), 946, 1019 (then عبقرية الإنسان), 1109, 1275, 1302, 1307, 1350, 1424, 1444/1446/1448 (instruction, then نواتج التعلم, then ثروات بلادي, then the first outcome), 1470, 1635. The 44-token line 528-571 is four welded blocks: fill-in item (538), instruction أحدد (548), map caption موقع دولة الإمارت ... (553; the source typo الإمارت confirms it is a caption, not body text), heading أقرأ وأستنتج (555). 788 is secured by the exact parallel at 1113-1128: an instruction line بالتعاون ... أستنتج وأجيب followed by a question, matching أناقش زملائي وأجيب عما يأتي on its own line. 296 is a claim followed by أدلل على صحة العبارة. HARD SITE 5, prose و/ف clauses, my only genuinely balanced calls, taken at med: 164 (وتعتز restates the full subject دولتنا الحبيبة الإمارات), 251 (واليوم flips قديما to the present), 263 (فتمتاز with a full NP subject), 589 (فكان للتجار, new subject; the doc puts فكان on its own line at 901), 832 (فحملوا opens the second half of a 49-token paragraph), 937 (فلنحرص, hortative), 987 (لذلك concludes the quote), and 172 at lo (ويبدو ذلك is anaphoric and could be comma-joined). I deliberately did NOT split: 153 كما (plausible comma), 236 فقد (evidential, tight), 213 and 680 وعلينا أن inside the two Zayed quotes (one utterance each), 977 وإنه (coordinated under فقال), 1178 ولعبوا (compact bullet, shared subject), 1259 فعملوا, 1289 وما تزال (coordinated predicate, same subject), 1624 نتج عنها, 361 in خطوط الطول وتعرف بأنها (term plus gloss is one definitional sentence, matching الموقع النسبي يعني at 305 and دوائر العرض عبارة عن at 382), and 1549 inside the slogan بيئة نظيفة حياة أجمل وأسعد. 1398 IS split despite having no connective, because تشكل دولة الإمارات جزءا هاما is a wholly new bullet fact, whereas وشاركوا just before it stays attached: the same contrast that keeps 1178 intact.
